python.title: Python
python.summary: Core language for analytics, scripting, and machine learning. Start here if you are new to programming.

youtube.title: Python for Beginners (Programming with Mosh, 3M+ views)
Python Tutorial for Beginners (Corey Schafer, 2M+ views)
Python Project - Build a Real-World App (freeCodeCamp)
Python for Everybody (Dr. Chuck full course)
Python for Data Science - Full Course (freeCodeCamp)
Python for Beginners in 4 Hours (duplicate hero kept for queue demo)

paths: Start with freeCodeCamp Python course → Kaggle Learn Python → build 3-5 automation scripts.
Follow Corey Schafer's Python playlist → read Automate the Boring Stuff → practice daily.
Study Real Python tutorials → implement projects → contribute to open source Python repos.
Master basics → OOP → decorators → async → build portfolio → follow roadmap.sh Python path.

stats.title: Statistics
stats.summary: Foundational statistics for data analysis: descriptive stats, probability, hypothesis testing, and regression.
paths: Complete Khan Academy Statistics → read Think Stats → practice with Python scipy.stats → apply to datasets.
Study descriptive stats → probability → distributions → hypothesis testing → regression → A/B testing.
Follow Analytics Vidhya statistics tutorials → Towards Data Science articles → practice on Kaggle datasets.
Master statistical concepts → implement tests → interpret results → communicate findings effectively.

math.title: Mathematics for Data Science
math.summary: Linear algebra, calculus, and discrete math needed for machine learning and data analysis.
paths: Watch 3Blue1Brown Linear Algebra series → practice with NumPy → understand matrix operations.
Study calculus basics → gradient descent → optimization for ML.
Learn linear algebra → matrix operations → eigenvalues → SVD for dimensionality reduction.
Apply math concepts by implementing ML algorithms from scratch.

oops.title: Object-Oriented Programming
oops.summary: OOP principles: classes, inheritance, polymorphism, and encapsulation. Essential for scalable code.
paths: Learn classes and objects → inheritance → polymorphism → design patterns.
Build a project using OOP: game, library system, or data processing pipeline.
Practice SOLID principles → refactor code → write maintainable classes.
Study design patterns: Factory, Singleton, Observer → apply in projects.

prompting.title: Prompt Engineering
prompting.summary: Crafting effective prompts for LLMs: few-shot learning, chain-of-thought, and prompt optimization.
paths: Complete DeepLearning.AI prompt engineering course → practice with ChatGPT → build prompt library.
Learn few-shot prompting → chain-of-thought → role-based prompts → test and iterate.
Master basic prompts → advanced techniques → prompt optimization → build LLM applications.
Practice on real tasks: summarization, code generation, data extraction → refine prompts.

sql.title: SQL
sql.summary: Query and aggregate data directly in databases. Essential for analytics work.

courses.name: CS50's Introduction to Databases with SQL

youtube.title: SQL Tutorial - Full Database Course (freeCodeCamp, 2M+ views)
CS50's Introduction to Databases with SQL (Harvard)

paths: Complete Kaggle Intro to SQL → Mode Analytics tutorial → practice on LeetCode SQL problems.
Follow CS50 SQL course → Danny Ma's 8-week challenge → build portfolio with real datasets.
Master SELECT/JOINs → window functions → CTEs → optimize queries → follow roadmap.sh SQL path.
Practice daily on HackerRank/LeetCode → read Mode blog → contribute SQL solutions to GitHub.

git.title: Git & GitHub
git.summary: Version control and collaboration for code and analytics notebooks.

youtube.title: Git & GitHub Crash Course (Traversy Media, 2M+ views)

paths: Learn Git basics → commits → branches → merges → GitHub → collaboration.
Master advanced Git → rebase → cherry-pick → hooks → resolve conflicts → optimize workflow.
Study GitHub features → issues → PRs → actions → pages → build portfolio.
Practice daily → contribute to open source → build GitHub profile → share projects.

pandas.title: Pandas
pandas.summary: Primary Python library for data wrangling, joins, and feature engineering.
paths: Complete Kaggle Pandas course → watch Corey Schafer's playlist → practice on real datasets.
Read Python Data Science Handbook → Analytics Vidhya tutorials → build data cleaning projects.
Master dataframes → filtering → grouping → merging → time series → optimize performance.
Practice daily on Kaggle datasets → contribute pandas solutions → follow best practices.

numpy.title: NumPy
numpy.summary: Fast arrays and math under the hood of most scientific Python libraries.
paths: Learn NumPy arrays → indexing → broadcasting → universal functions → optimize performance.
Master array operations → linear algebra → random numbers → file I/O → build numerical applications.
Study vectorization → memory management → performance tips → integrate with pandas/scipy.
Practice on Kaggle → solve 100 NumPy exercises → contribute to NumPy → build projects.

matplotlib.title: Visualization
matplotlib.summary: Matplotlib/Seaborn fundamentals for static plots in Python.
paths: Learn matplotlib basics → plots → customization → subplots → save figures.
Master Seaborn → statistical plots → styling → build publication-ready visualizations.
Study plot types → color schemes → annotations → interactive plots → create dashboards.
Practice on datasets → create 20+ visualizations → build portfolio → share on GitHub.

excel.title: Excel
excel.summary: Spreadsheet skills for analysts: formulas, pivots, and dashboards.
paths: Learn Excel basics → formulas → pivot tables → charts → build dashboards → automate tasks.
Master VLOOKUP → INDEX/MATCH → array formulas → Power Query → Power Pivot → advanced analytics.
Study ExcelJet tutorials → Chandoo.org → Analytics Vidhya → practice on real datasets.
Build projects: financial models → dashboards → automation → share templates → optimize workflows.

power-bi.title: Power BI
power-bi.summary: Microsoft BI stack: self-service dashboards on top of data models.

courses.name: Guy in a Cube · Power BI Training

youtube.title: Power BI Tutorial (Guy in a Cube, 500K+ views)
Power BI Tutorials Playlist (Guy in a Cube)

paths: Complete Microsoft Learn Power BI → watch Guy in a Cube tutorials → build 5-10 dashboards.
Master data modeling → DAX → Power Query → visuals → publish reports → share insights.
Study RADACAD blog → SQLBI → Analytics Vidhya → practice on real datasets → optimize performance.
Build portfolio: dashboards → data models → DAX formulas → publish to Power BI Service.

tableau.title: Tableau
tableau.summary: Drag-and-drop BI with strong visual defaults and a huge community gallery.
paths: Complete Tableau training → practice on Tableau Public → build 10+ visualizations → publish gallery.
Master data connections → calculations → LOD expressions → dashboards → storytelling → share work.
Study Tableau blog → Analytics Vidhya → explore Public Gallery → practice daily → optimize designs.
Build portfolio: dashboards → data stories → calculations → publish to Tableau Public → get feedback.

business-analytics.title: Business Analytics
business-analytics.summary: Translating business questions into metrics, dashboards, and data stories. Mix of Excel, BI tools, and SQL.
paths: Get comfortable with Excel → learn basic SQL → build 3–4 dashboards in Power BI or Tableau from public datasets.
Follow roadmap.sh Data Analyst roadmap → master metrics → storytelling → build portfolio → present insights.
Study Analytics Vidhya tutorials → Towards Data Science articles → practice on business cases → optimize dashboards.
Learn business metrics → KPIs → dashboard design → data storytelling → share work → get feedback.

data-science.title: Data Science
data-science.summary: End‑to‑end analytics and ML: cleaning data, modeling, evaluation, and communication.

books.name: Hands-On Machine Learning with Scikit-Learn, Keras & TensorFlow

paths: Follow roadmap.sh AI & Data Scientist roadmap → master Python + pandas + SQL → do 5–10 Kaggle projects.
Complete IBM/Google Data Science certificate → read Hands-On ML → re‑implement notebooks → build portfolio.
Study Analytics Vidhya tutorials → Towards Data Science articles → practice on real datasets → publish insights.
Learn EDA → feature engineering → modeling → evaluation → deployment → follow MLOps practices.

data-engineering.title: Data Engineering
data-engineering.summary: Pipelines, warehouses, and tooling that make analytics and ML possible at scale.

courses.name: Google Cloud · Data Engineer learning path

paths: Follow roadmap.sh Data Engineer roadmap → strengthen SQL + Python → learn cloud → complete Zoomcamp.
Master ETL/ELT → data lakes → warehouses → orchestration → streaming → build end-to-end pipelines.
Study Analytics Vidhya tutorials → Towards Data Science articles → practice on real projects.
Build projects: data pipelines → orchestrate workflows → optimize performance → deploy to production.

machine-learning.title: Machine Learning
machine-learning.summary: Classical ML: regression, trees, ensembles, model evaluation, and feature engineering.

books.name: Hands-On Machine Learning with Scikit-Learn, Keras & TensorFlow

paths: Follow roadmap.sh ML roadmap → complete Andrew Ng's course → Kaggle Intro + Intermediate ML → build projects.
Read Hands-On ML → re‑implement models with scikit‑learn → improve 2–3 Kaggle solutions → publish on GitHub.
Study Analytics Vidhya ML tutorials → Towards Data Science articles → practice on real datasets → deploy models.
Master supervised learning → unsupervised learning → ensemble methods → model evaluation → MLOps.

deep-learning.title: Deep Learning
deep-learning.summary: Neural networks, CNNs, RNNs, transformers, and training tricks.

courses.name: fast.ai · Practical Deep Learning for Coders

paths: Do fast.ai Practical DL → build 2–3 image or tabular DL projects → read Deep Learning book chapters.
Complete DeepLearning.AI specialization → watch CS231n → implement CNNs/RNNs → build portfolio.
Study Analytics Vidhya tutorials → Towards Data Science articles → practice on Kaggle/Hugging Face.
Master neural networks → CNNs → RNNs → transformers → optimize training → deploy models.

llms.title: LLMs & Generative AI
llms.summary: Working with large language models: prompting, fine‑tuning, retrieval, and evaluation.

books.name: Generative AI with Large Language Models

paths: Learn basic prompting → build tools with LLM APIs → explore RAG → fine-tuning → evaluation.
Follow roadmap.sh AI Engineer roadmap → deployment → vector DBs → observability → production.
Study Analytics Vidhya LLM tutorials → Towards Data Science articles → build applications.
Master prompting → RAG → fine-tuning → evaluation → deploy LLM apps → share on GitHub.

nlp.title: NLP (Natural Language Processing)
nlp.summary: Text preprocessing, embeddings, sequence models, and modern transformer-based NLP.

courses.name: CS224n · Natural Language Processing with Deep Learning

books.name: Speech and Language Processing (Jurafsky & Martin, free)

paths: Complete Hugging Face NLP course → implement text classification → QA model → build applications.
Watch CS224n lectures → read Jurafsky & Martin → study transformers → fine-tune models.
Study Analytics Vidhya NLP tutorials → Towards Data Science articles → practice on datasets.
Master text preprocessing → embeddings → sequence models → transformers → deploy NLP apps.

data-analytics.title: Data Analytics
data-analytics.summary: Analyzing data to extract insights: SQL queries, dashboards, and business metrics.
paths: Follow roadmap.sh Data Analyst roadmap → master SQL → learn Excel/Power BI → build 5-10 dashboards.
Complete Google Data Analytics certificate → practice on real business questions → present findings → build portfolio.
Study Analytics Vidhya tutorials → Towards Data Science articles → Analytics India Magazine → practice daily.
Learn data cleaning → EDA → visualization → storytelling → dashboard creation → share insights on GitHub.

data-visualization.title: Data Visualization
data-visualization.summary: Creating compelling visualizations: charts, dashboards, and interactive graphics.

books.name: The Visual Display of Quantitative Information

paths: Learn matplotlib/seaborn → Tableau/Power BI → D3.js for interactivity → build portfolio.
Study design principles → color theory → chart selection → create 10+ visualizations.
Master static charts → interactive dashboards → storytelling → publish on Tableau Public.
Practice with real datasets → experiment with different chart types → get feedback → iterate.

product-analytics.title: Product Analytics
product-analytics.summary: Analyzing user behavior, product metrics, A/B testing, and feature adoption.

books.name: Hooked: How to Build Habit-Forming Products

paths: Learn Google Analytics → Mixpanel/Amplitude → SQL for custom queries → build dashboards.
Master funnel analysis → cohort analysis → retention metrics → A/B testing → present insights.
Study product metrics (DAU, MAU, retention) → event tracking → user segmentation → recommendations.
Practice on real products → analyze user journeys → identify drop-offs → suggest improvements.

opencv.title: OpenCV & Computer Vision
opencv.summary: Image processing, object detection, face recognition, and computer vision applications.
paths: Learn image basics → filtering → edge detection → object detection → build projects.
Master OpenCV basics → face detection → image segmentation → deep learning with OpenCV.
Study image processing → feature extraction → template matching → real-time applications.
Build projects: face recognition, object tracking, image filters → deploy with Flask/FastAPI.

mlops.title: MLOps
mlops.summary: Deploying, monitoring, and maintaining ML models in production: CI/CD, model versioning, and monitoring.

books.name: MLOps: Continuous delivery and automation pipelines

paths: Learn Docker → MLflow → model serving → CI/CD → monitoring → build end-to-end pipeline.
Master model versioning → experiment tracking → model registry → deployment → A/B testing.
Study containerization → orchestration (Kubernetes) → model monitoring → retraining pipelines.
Build projects: deploy model → set up monitoring → automate retraining → scale infrastructure.

devops.title: DevOps
devops.summary: CI/CD, containerization, cloud infrastructure, and automation for data/ML pipelines.
paths: Learn Linux basics → Git → Docker → Kubernetes → CI/CD → cloud (AWS/GCP) → monitoring.
Master version control → containerization → orchestration → infrastructure as code → automation.
Study CI/CD pipelines → container registries → cloud services → monitoring/logging → security.
Build projects: containerize app → set up CI/CD → deploy to cloud → monitor and scale.

spark.title: Apache Spark
spark.summary: Big Data processing engine for large-scale data analytics: Spark SQL, Streaming, MLlib.
paths: Learn Spark basics → Spark SQL → Spark Streaming → MLlib → build end-to-end pipelines.
Master RDDs → DataFrames → Catalyst optimizer → performance tuning → deploy on clusters.
Study Databricks tutorials → Analytics Vidhya articles → practice on large datasets → optimize jobs.
Build projects: ETL pipelines → real-time processing → ML workflows → scale to production.

cloud-data.title: Cloud Data Platforms
cloud-data.summary: AWS, GCP, Azure data services: data lakes, warehouses, and analytics platforms.
paths: Choose one cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure) → learn data services → build data pipelines → deploy analytics.
Master S3/Data Lake → Redshift/BigQuery → Glue/Dataflow → build end-to-end data platform.
Study cloud data architecture → cost optimization → security → monitoring → scale solutions.
Build projects: data ingestion → transformation → warehousing → analytics → share on GitHub.

databases.title: Databases
databases.summary: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis: relational and NoSQL databases for data storage and retrieval.
paths: Learn PostgreSQL basics → advanced queries → indexing → performance tuning → replication.
Master MongoDB → document modeling → aggregation → sharding → build NoSQL applications.
Study Redis → caching patterns → pub/sub → data structures → optimize application performance.
Build projects: design schemas → optimize queries → implement caching → deploy databases.

data-warehousing.title: Data Warehousing
data-warehousing.summary: Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift: cloud data warehouses for analytics at scale.
paths: Learn data warehousing concepts → choose platform (Snowflake/BigQuery/Redshift) → build warehouse.
Master dimensional modeling → ETL/ELT → data quality → performance optimization → cost management.
Study Kimball methodology → modern data stack → dbt for transformations → build analytics layer.
Build projects: design schema → load data → create views → optimize queries → build dashboards.

streaming.title: Streaming Data
streaming.summary: Kafka, Spark Streaming, Flink: real-time data processing and event streaming.
paths: Learn Kafka basics → producers/consumers → topics/partitions → streaming applications.
Master event streaming → Kafka Streams → Spark Streaming → Flink → real-time analytics.
Study streaming patterns → exactly-once semantics → fault tolerance → scale streaming pipelines.
Build projects: event-driven architecture → real-time ETL → stream processing → monitoring.

time-series.title: Time Series Analysis
time-series.summary: Forecasting, trend analysis, and temporal data modeling for time-dependent datasets.
paths: Learn time series basics → decomposition → ARIMA → forecasting → evaluate models.
Master Prophet → LSTM → Transformer models → build forecasting pipelines → deploy predictions.
Study seasonality → trend analysis → anomaly detection → build time series dashboards.
Practice on real datasets: sales forecasting → stock prediction → demand planning → share insights.

feature-engineering.title: Feature Engineering
feature-engineering.summary: Creating, selecting, and transforming features to improve ML model performance.

books.name: Feature Engineering for Machine Learning (free preview)

paths: Learn feature creation → transformation → selection → build feature pipelines → improve models.
Master encoding → scaling → imputation → feature selection → dimensionality reduction.
Study domain-specific features → automated feature engineering → feature stores → production.
Practice on Kaggle competitions → build feature libraries → share techniques → optimize models.

computer-vision.title: Computer Vision
computer-vision.summary: Image classification, object detection, segmentation, and vision-based ML applications.
paths: Learn image basics → CNNs → transfer learning → object detection → build vision models.
Master OpenCV → PyTorch/TensorFlow → YOLO → segmentation → deploy vision applications.
Study image preprocessing → data augmentation → model architectures → optimize performance.
Build projects: image classification → object detection → face recognition → share on GitHub.

reinforcement-learning.title: Reinforcement Learning
reinforcement-learning.summary: RL algorithms: Q-learning, policy gradients, and deep RL for decision-making systems.
paths: Learn RL basics → Q-learning → policy gradients → deep RL → build agents.
Master OpenAI Gym → stable-baselines3 → train agents → evaluate performance → deploy.
Study multi-armed bandits → MDPs → value functions → explore-exploit → optimize policies.
Build projects: game agents → robotics → recommendation systems → share implementations.

ab-testing.title: A/B Testing & Experimentation
ab-testing.summary: Designing experiments, statistical testing, and analyzing results for data-driven decisions.
paths: Learn experiment design → hypothesis testing → sample size → analyze results → make decisions.
Master statistical tests → confidence intervals → p-values → multiple comparisons → interpret findings.
Study randomization → control groups → metrics selection → build experimentation platform.
Practice on real experiments → design tests → analyze data → present insights → optimize products.

airflow.title: Apache Airflow
airflow.summary: Workflow orchestration for data pipelines: scheduling, monitoring, and managing ETL jobs.
paths: Learn Airflow basics → DAGs → operators → scheduling → monitoring → build pipelines.
Master task dependencies → XComs → sensors → hooks → custom operators → production deployment.
Study workflow patterns → error handling → retries → SLA → optimize DAG performance.
Build projects: ETL pipelines → data quality checks → orchestrate workflows → monitor jobs.

dbt.title: dbt (Data Build Tool)

paths: Learn dbt basics → models → tests → documentation → build transformation layer.
Master SQL transformations → Jinja templating → macros → incremental models → production.
Study analytics engineering → data modeling → testing strategies → CI/CD → optimize queries.
Build projects: transform raw data → create marts → document models → share transformations.

r.title: R Programming

paths: Learn R basics → tidyverse → data visualization → statistical modeling → build analyses.
Master dplyr → ggplot2 → Shiny → R Markdown → create reproducible research.
Study statistical tests → regression → time series → build R packages → share code.
Practice on datasets → create visualizations → build dashboards → publish analyses.
